newsitem.title: USA: Sequus drops offering of preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: Sequus drops offering of preferred shares.

text.p: Sequus Pharmaceuticals Inc said Friday it was withdrawing its proposed public offering of 1.0 million convertible preferred shares due to "poor market conditions."

I. Craig Henderson, chairman and chief executive, said interest in the offering was strong but "the current softness in the stock market makes the pricing of this offering unattractive to the company."
Scott Minick, president and chief operating officer, said that Sequus has sufficient resources and that termination of the offering will not have a negative impact on the company.
Sequus is developing and commercializing pharmaceutical products primarily to treat cancer and infectious diseases.
